title: Probiotics and Hospital Outcome in the Elderly
brief_summary: Probiotics have been shown to reduce the rate of diarrhea and constipation. The purpose of this study was to investigate if probiotics could improve outcome of hospitalized orthopedic elderly patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who were hospitalized in the Department of Geriatric Orthopedic Rehabilitation a week before their enrollment in the study and signed an informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known or suspected allergy to any probiotics
* Neutropenia
* Inability to sign an informed consent
